BiblicalUsage: The name is Rumah, a place in Palestine. You find the name in 2 Kings 23:36: "…began to reign; and he reigned eleven years…".
TheologicalSignificance: My position is that Rumah counts, because the God of the Bible works in places you can find. I hold that no name in Scripture is there by accident.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
